description.narrative: The Fund will finance initiatives that (a) enable governments and communities to tackle the health emergency, (b) focus on social impacts, and the economic response and recovery; and (c) help countries recover better by building more equal, inclusive and sustainable economies and societies that are better equipped to tackle the many other global challenges we face.
